scenarios.name: buggy_pr_must_flag_planted_issues
scenarios.description: Verifies the agent applies the checklist when planted issues exist. A rubber-stamping agent ('LGTM') fails this scenario.

scenarios.name: clean_pr_no_false_positives
scenarios.description: Verifies the agent does not invent issues on a clean diff. An over-eager agent that flags every change fails this scenario.
